text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr! I got my butt kicked again!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: There's no way I can look an Umamusume in the face in this condition…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Even though I—more than anyone else—am here trying to pay respect to them.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I was all talk. I couldn't do it at all… I don't even deserve to call myself a simp!
choice_data_list: So you're giving up on running with your oshis?
So you're giving up on running with your oshis?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I was all talk. I couldn't do it at all… I don't even deserve to call myself a simp!
choice_data_list: So you're giving up on running with your oshis?
So you're giving up on running with your oshis?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: I know how serious you are.
I know how serious you are.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Really? You think I can try my best for my oshis?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Gyuh… Th-thank you! I guess I lost myself there for a moment…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: How could I ever doubt the love I feel?! I'm going to run for them! I'm going to get stronger… for them!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Because that is how I simp!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thank you! You've helped me remember something very important!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Digital renews her will to fight and looks firmly to the future.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I don't want to cause any trouble… I just want to watch them from a distance closer than anyone else can get!
choice_data_list: In that case, let's do our best!
In that case, let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
choice_data_list: As long as you have that fiery passion, you'll definitely be okay!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Fiery… passion… That's right! If nothing else, I have absolute confidence in this fire burning in my heart!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I'm gonna run until I burn out in a blaze of glory!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: But even then, my ashes will take to the wind so I can chase my oshis to the ends of the Earth!
